Defying the Lycan King

Chapter 1: The Hated One
  • Next Chapter

Derek stayed exactly where he was on the ground, still in his beast form, watching as the brilliant white glow that had surrounded her began to dim.

Every single person still alive in that courtyard stared at her, frozen, completely forgetting there had been a battle raging only seconds before.

She has spent her life believing she's cursed, but tonight everything changed.
